text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Gulf Air moves to trim costs by cutting more jobs. At least 400 more jobs are to be eliminated under a cost-cutting campaign.
- Arab Insurance Group shareholders are to consider and approve a proposed public share issue aimed at raising around $200 million of new capital for the firm.
- Bahrain and Algeria to form a cooperative committee this year.
